messages:
sam: Quick sync - FinRegCo wants a 2-week POC strictly processing in the EU with a canary failover plan. They asked for: region-by-region sub-processor list, an explicit routing policy (deny vs failover), and a short pricing comparison: Dedicated reserved vs hosted with geo-fallback. Also they flagged security Q10 about traces/logs leaving the EU. cc @ida @maria

ida: On it. Can ops size the pool? need SAML org id and expected qps/typical sequence length to price Dedicated.

sam: SAML org id FINREG-002. Expected: 20 rps baseline, spikes to ~110 rps. Typical prompt+gen ~450 tokens, KV lengths small but peaks at 1024 on a few flows.

maria: Legal note: we can provide SCCs and a sub-processor appendix. Hosted control-plane may send anonymized metrics outside EU unless we enable EU-only telemetry. For Dedicated/Private we can keep logs and traces in-region; need ops to confirm retention and audit-log sinks.

jonah: Infra breakdown: default behaviors differ by deployment:
- Dedicated/Private: storage and logging can be pinned to a chosen EU region (no cross-region replication unless requested)
- Hosted: control plane is global; we offer a "eu-only-telemetry" toggle but that will disable automatic cross-region fallback.

jonah: Draft routing snippet for POC runbook (ops will template):
```yaml
routing:
  primary_region: eu-central-1
  failover_region: eu-west-1
  failover_behavior: deny # options: deny, fallback_with_alert, silent_fallback
  telemetry_region: eu-central-1
  subprocessor_disclosure: full
```

ida: Ops can provision a 3xA100 Dedicated pool for the 2-week POC. Ballpark pricing: Dedicated short-term reserved ~ "$6.8k/week" (includes warm-up/priority). Hosted w/ geo-fallback estimated run-rate ~ "$2.9k/week" but has potential egress charges and no guaranteed region pinning. I'll draft a quote with both options and callouts.

kelly: I can provision once PO + allowlist is in. I'll start the sub-processor spreadsheet and tag regional partners (AWS eu-west-1, GCP eu-west-1, Azure northeurope, Datadog EU) - link: https://redwood-internal/ops/subproc-eu-poc

sec-review-bot: Draft answer to security Q10: "For Dedicated and Private deployments, application logs and request traces are stored in the selected EU region and are not replicated to other regions unless customer authorizes replication. For Hosted deployments, control-plane telemetry is centralized; we offer an EU-only telemetry option that keeps telemetry within the EU but disables cross-region failover. Detailed telemetry routing and retention are documented at https://redwood-internal/security/telemetry-routing."

maria: Two legal clarifications: 1) Is Datadog EU-only tenant acceptable for their vendor policy? 2) Do they require HSM-backed KMS for key storage? If yes, that adds to timeline.

sam: Good questions. Customer will confirm vendor list by EOD. Next steps: (1) Ida: quote both options + include routing snippet; (2) Kelly: prepare subproc list + provisioning checklist; (3) Jonah: short runbook for enabling eu-only telemetry and the operational impact (no automatic failover); (4) Maria: prepare SCC appendix and conditional contractual language. I'll compile and send to prospect end of day. :thumbsup:
